title: Slovakian Veal Bao
description: A traditional Slovakian dish, this veal bao recipe combines the flavors of the region with the convenience of a bao.

ingredients.name: Bao buns
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Slovakian paprika
ingredients.notes: mild or hot, depending on preference

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the Slovakian paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the thinly sliced veal and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the herbaceous sauce and stir to coat the veal.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Split the bao buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the bao by spooning the veal and sauce mixture into the buns.
Top with sour cream and chopped parsley, if desired.
